## I LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS

## Scope and interpretation

## 56.1

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.1] (1) In this Section of this Part ‘landlord and tenant claim’ means a claim under –

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.1] (a) the Landlord and Tenant Act 1927 1 ;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.1] (b) the Leasehold Property (Repairs) Act 1938 2 ;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.1] (c) the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954 3 ;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.1] (d) the Landlord and Tenant Act 1985 4 ;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.1] (e) the Landlord and Tenant Act 1987 5 ; or

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.1] (f) section 214 of the Housing Act 2004 6 .

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.1] (2) A practice direction may set out special provisions with regard to any particular category of landlord and tenant claim.

## Starting the claim

## 56.2

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.2] (1) In the County Court—

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.2] (a) the claim may be made at any County Court hearing centre, unless paragraph (2) applies or an enactment provides otherwise;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.2] (b) the claim will be issued by the hearing centre where the claim is made; and

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.2] (c) if the claim is not made at the County Court hearing centre which serves the address where the land is situated, the claim will be sent to the hearing centre serving that address.

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.2] (Practice Direction 56 includes further direction in respect of claims which are not made at the County Court hearing centre which serves the address where the land is situated.)

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.2] (2) Unless an enactment provides otherwise, the claim may be started in the High Court if the claimant files with the claim form a certificate stating the reasons for bringing the claim in that court verified by a statement of truth.

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.2] (3) Practice Direction 56 refers to circumstances which may justify starting the claim in the High Court.

## 56.3

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (1) This rule applies to a claim for a new tenancy under section 24 and to a claim for the termination of a tenancy under section 29(2) of the 1954 Act.

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (2) In this rule –

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (a) ‘the 1954 Act’ means the Landlord and Tenant Act 1954;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (b) ‘an unopposed claim’ means a claim for a new tenancy under section 24 of the 1954 Act in circumstances where the grant of a new tenancy is not opposed;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (c) ‘an opposed claim’ means a claim for –

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (i) a new tenancy under section 24 of the 1954 Act in circumstances where the grant of a new tenancy is opposed; or

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (ii) the termination of a tenancy under section 29(2) of the 1954 Act.

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (3) Where the claim is an unopposed claim –

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (a) the claimant must use the Part 8 procedure, but the following rules do not apply –

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (i) rule 8.5; and

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (ii) rule 8.6; and

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (b) Omitted

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (c) the court will give directions about the future management of the claim following receipt of the acknowledgment of service.

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (4) Where the claim is an opposed claim the claimant must use the Part 7 procedure.

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.3] (Practice Direction 56 contains provisions about evidence, including expert evidence in opposed claims)

## II MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND

## Scope

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > Scope] 56.4 A practice direction may set out special provisions with regard to claims under the following enactments –

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > Scope] (a) the Chancel Repairs Act 1932 8 ;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > Scope] (b) the Leasehold Reform Act 1967 9 ;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > Scope] (c) the Access to Neighbouring Land Act 1992 10 ; #fn10

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > Scope] (d) the Leasehold Reform, Housing and Urban Development Act 1993 11 ; and

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > Scope] (e) the Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Act 2002 12 .

## III APPLICATIONS AND CLAIMS TO THE COURT UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016

## Scope and interpretation

## 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —] (a)“the 2016 Act” means the Renting Homes (Wales) Act 2016;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —] (b)“Renting Homes (Wales) claim” means a claim or application under the 2016 Act other than a claim —

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —] (i)for possession;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —] (ii)for a prohibited conduct standard contract order under section 116(2) of the 2016 Act;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —] (iii)to which the Pre-Action Protocol for Housing Disrepair Cases applies; or

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —] (iv)brought in the same proceedings as a claim referred to in paragraphs (i) to (iii);

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —] and includes an appeal under section 78(3) of the 2016 Act;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.5 (1) In this Section of this Part —] (c)“the claimant” means the person making the Renting Homes (Wales) claim, irrespective of whether it is a claim or application under the 2016 Act.

## Making the Renting Homes (Wales) claim

## 56.6 In the County Court, the Renting Homes (Wales) claim—

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.6 In the County Court, the Renting Homes (Wales) claim—] (a)may be made at any County Court hearing centre;

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.6 In the County Court, the Renting Homes (Wales) claim—] (b)is to be issued by the hearing centre where the claim is made; and

[PART 56 – LANDLORD AND TENANT CLAIMS AND MISCELLANEOUS PROVISIONS ABOUT LAND AND CLAIMS UNDER THE RENTING HOMES (WALES) ACT 2016 > 56.6 In the County Court, the Renting Homes (Wales) claim—] (c)if not made at the County Court hearing centre which serves the address where the land is situated, is to be sent to the hearing centre serving that address.

## Further provision for Renting Homes (Wales) claims

## 56.7 A practice direction may set out provisions with regard to Renting Homes (Wales) claims.
